instagram.caption:
In Space Invaders the aliens speed up because the hardware was too slow.

The 1978 machine couldn't move 55 aliens quickly. Every one you shot freed up a bit of power, so the rest moved faster.

Creator Tomohiro Nishikado liked the rising panic and kept it. It became one of the first difficulty curves in gaming.
